note: The data is not published (see docs/REPORT.md, Data). These digests identify the exact files the results were computed from, so a copy shown to a reviewer can be checked against them.

corpus_l6.parquet.what: the frozen corpus snapshot every number is measured on

sym_l6.parquet.what: the same corpus, corners symmetrised (a deterministic half flipped)

featsmir_l6_v15.parquet.what: the same matrix with the corners exchanged

polymarket_boxing.parquet.what: Polymarket boxing trades, from the on-chain history

proboxingodds_v3.parquet.what: the ProBoxingOdds re-crawl with the fixed parser: opening prices for pre-registration 2, window A

odds_external/betsapi.parquet.what: Bet365 opening and closing lines from BetsAPI, as of 2026-09-23 16:44 MSK: the e-value audits and window B
